strategy: Capture dominant share in the global fastening industry by evolving from a commodity manufacturer into a platform-based B2B subscription service that guarantees uninterrupted office-supply workflows. Build a vertically integrated, sustainable manufacturing architecture anchored by regional micro-factories to eliminate supply-chain fragility and enable same-day fulfillment. Deliver a modular product-design layer that lets enterprise clients co-create bespoke paperclip variants and integrate orders directly into their procurement systems via API-first infrastructure.
